context: A grandpa and grandkid spend a day
purpose: Teach: 夜明け/粘土/鴨/ピエロ/根っこ/裾/根気/生意気

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、夜明けって、見たこと、ある?
lines.en: Grandpa, have you ever seen the dawn?
lines.style: Soft, curious question. Small hesitation on "dawn" — testing out a word he's heard adults use. Lean-in interest, unguarded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん。畑仕事のあと、粘土で、玩具を作って遊んだものだ。
lines.en: I have. After the fieldwork was done, I'd make toys from clay and play with them.
lines.style: Gentle, slow-paced remembering. Voice settles into the image. No rush. Eyes distant but warm. A small smile lives in the pauses.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 池の鴨、おじいちゃん、餌、あげようよ。
lines.en: Grandpa, the ducks at the pond — let's feed them!
lines.style: Sudden brightness. Energy lifting his whole voice. Quick breath before the question, like the thought just arrived. Tugging-at-sleeve excitement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔のサーカス、ピエロさん、面白かったな、子供の頃。
lines.en: The old circus we saw when I was a boy — the clown was so funny.
lines.style: Drifting, unprompted memory. Not answering the immediate offer, but thinking aloud. Warm, caught in time. Voice trails into the past.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 木の根っこ、すごく大きいね、これ!
lines.en: This tree root is so huge!
lines.style: Bright exclamation, genuine awe. Voice opens up on 'huge' — no holding back. Child's complete absorption in the present moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お洋服の裾、汚れたな、翔くん、気をつけて。
lines.en: Your clothes have gotten dirty, Sho. Watch your step.
lines.style: Soft, practiced care. Not scolding — noticing. Gentle redirect. The tone of someone watching closely without fussing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 勉強、根気よく続けるって、ママ、言ってたよ。
lines.en: Mom says you have to keep studying and not give up.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly formal—repeating something he knows matters. Proud to know the words. Small gravity in his delivery, like he's sharing something important.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 生意気なことを言うようになったな、翔くん、頼もしい。
lines.en: You're getting clever in your words, Sho. That's reassuring.
lines.style: Quiet pride, genuine. Warmth without performance. A simple acknowledgment that lands. Eyes crinkling at the corners.
